label: Tweet
guide: One post for X. 280 characters at most. One idea. No hashtags unless the samples use them.

label: Thread
guide: A thread for X of 4 to 8 posts, each 280 characters at most, separated by a blank line. The first post carries the idea by itself.

label: LinkedIn post
guide: A LinkedIn post of 120 to 250 words. The first two lines must make sense before the reader clicks to expand.

label: Instagram caption
guide: An Instagram caption of 80 to 200 words that adds an angle a photo or carousel would leave out. End with one plain invitation to reply or act, if the samples do that.

label: Email broadcast
guide: One email to the whole list. First line: 'Subject: ...' (under 50 characters). Then the body, 150 to 350 words, written to one reader, with a single link or ask.

label: Long-form paragraph
guide: One full paragraph of 150 to 250 words, of the kind that sits in a newsletter, an essay or a sales page.
